title: Crepuscle
summary: CREPUSCLE, CREPUSCULE, noun [Latin , a little burst or break of light, or broken light.] Twilight; the light of the morning from the first dawn to sunrise, and of the evening from sunset to darkness.

inlines.v: CREPUSCLE, CREPUSCULE, noun [Latin , a little burst or break of light, or broken light.] Twilight; the light of the morning from the first dawn to sunrise, and of the evening from sunset to darkness. It is occasioned by the refraction of the suns ray.
